decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with green devotion cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Llanowar Elves, while also utilizing cards like Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Old-Growth Troll to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and strong spells like Invasion of Ixalan, ultimately aiming to win the match through aggressive play and efficient mana usage.

The main concept of this UW Control deck is to control the game through removal spells, counterspells, and card draw, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with card advantage and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. The deck also aims to stabilize the board with sweepers like Supreme Verdict and protect its life total with cards like Dovin's Veto. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value with blink effects. The deck is well-rounded with a focus on reactive plays and long-term card advantage.

The main strategy of this Dimir Control deck in Pioneer 1 vs 1 format revolves around utilizing cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Narset, Parter of Veils to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage with Omen of the Sea and Yorion, Sky Nomad. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells and counterspells while setting up powerful win conditions such as Hopeless Nightmare and The Meathook Massacre. By efficiently managing resources and denying the opponent's game plan, the deck seeks to outvalue the opponent and secure victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence early on through cards like Bloodtithe Harvester and Mutavault, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Fatal Push and Duress. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Blade of the Oni ensures that the deck has options for finishing the game quickly if the opponent manages to stabilize. Additionally, cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional card advantage to help maintain pressure on the opponent.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays, quick removal, and disruption to overwhelm opponents. The deck includes powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, along with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. It also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the opponent's hand. The deck aims to quickly establish board presence and pressure the opponent, while also disrupting their game plan with targeted removal and hand disruption spells.

The main idea of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, aggressive creature plays like Emberheart Challenger, Monastery Swiftspear, and Heartfire Hero. Using cards like Infuriate and Reckless Rage to pump up creatures and deal damage, while utilizing Den of the Bugbear for additional creature threats. The deck also includes burn spells like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance to finish off opponents quickly. With a focus on rapid damage output and aggressive tactics, this deck aims to win the game swiftly before the opponent can establish their own board presence.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with fast, aggressive creatures and burn spells. It aims to control the board and deal damage as quickly as possible before the opponent can stabilize. The key strategy is to maintain a steady stream of threats on the board while using burn spells to clear blockers or deal direct damage to the opponent. The deck aims to end the game quickly before the opponent's late-game threats can take over.

This UW Control deck focuses on utilizing Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion to maximize the value of its ETB effects and create a strong card advantage. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Supreme Verdict and Dovin's Veto while generating card advantage through cards like Memory Deluge and Omen of the Sea. The inclusion of March of Otherworldly Light and The Wandering Emperor provides additional protection and disruption against opponents. This deck thrives on out-valuing opponents while maintaining board control and disrupting their game plan.

The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes cards like Thoughtseize and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to disrupt the opponent's strategy while ramping into the combo pieces. Additionally, the deck includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Vanishing Verse to deal with threats and protect the combo. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently deploying key cards and executing the combo to secure victory.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Duress and Thoughtseize. It also utilizes powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to pressure the opponent. The deck has removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with threats, while also having some card advantage with Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. Overall, the key strategy of this deck is to apply pressure early on and control the board to secure a quick victory.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells in order to quickly reduce their life total to zero. The deck focuses on playing efficient, low-cost creatures like Manifold Mouse and Heartfire Hero, while also using powerful burn spells like Burst Lightning and Monstrous Rage to finish off the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Inti, Seneschal of the Sun and Kumano Faces Kakkazan provide additional reach and utility to help secure victory. Manifold Mouse and Rockface Village are included for additional creature recursion and card advantage.

This Merfolk aggro deck focuses on swarming the board with Merfolk creatures to overwhelm the opponent quickly. It utilizes cards like Kumena, Tyrant of Orazca, Tishana's Tidebinder, and Vodalian Hexcatcher to build a strong board presence while also using cards like Collected Company to quickly refill the board with more creatures. With a mix of aggressive creatures and support cards, the deck aims to establish dominance on the battlefield early and maintain pressure throughout the game to secure a victory.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing various spells and abilities to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage. The deck focuses on using cards like Narset, Parter of Veils for card draw suppression, Thoughtseize for hand disruption, and Fatal Push for removal. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a companion, providing additional value with its flicker effect. The deck also includes a mix of lands and creatures to support its control strategy, such as Mutavault and Stormchaser's Talent.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with instants and sorceries to bring back Arclight Phoenix, using cards like Treasure Cruise and Fiery Impulse to enable this strategy. It also includes cards like Picklock Prankster and Hall of Storm Giants to provide additional threats and card advantage. By combining card draw, burn spells, and evasion, this aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents early in the game and maintain pressure throughout the match. Additionally, cards like Consider and Sleight of Hand help dig for crucial pieces to execute its game plan effectively.

This Rakdos aggro deck focuses on aggression and disruption to quickly overwhelm opponents. It utilizes a mixture of efficient creatures, removal spells, and hand disruption to maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while presenting a fast clock with evasive threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also includes versatile removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy to secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a combination of early creature threats and disruptive spells to control the opponent's strategy. The key strategy is to apply pressure with efficient creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse while disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck also utilizes removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the goal is to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total and maintain control of the board to secure victory.
